description: This file defines the AppendOp class, a scaffold operation for appending or prepending content to files within a Drupal project, including methods for content generation, processing, and handling existing files.

classes.name: AppendOp
classes.description: A class representing a scaffold operation to append or prepend content to files in a Drupal project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AppendOp instance with optional paths for prepend, append, default data, and a force-append flag.

methods.name: generateContents
methods.description: Generates the combined content to be written to the target file, including prepend, original, and append contents.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the append operation, writing the generated content to the destination file and providing IO feedback.

methods.name: scaffoldOverExistingTarget
methods.description: Sets the original contents from an existing target file for scaffolding purposes.

methods.name: scaffoldAtNewLocation
methods.description: Handles scaffolding at a new location, determining if the operation should be skipped or executed based on file existence and data.

methods.name: existingFileHasData
methods.description: Checks if the target file already contains the data to be appended or prepended.
